title: Reshaping the scissors: From directed evolution to AI-driven design for enhanced Cas performance.
authors: Cheng, Xinrui; Ruan, Weimin; Jin, Zheng; Suo, Langda; Ma, Yuehui; Jiang, Lin; Zheng, Wenxin; Li, Ning; Hu, Wenping
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统梳理了Cas蛋白定向进化、理性结构设计与AI辅助工程化的三层优化框架，虽聚焦工具改造策略而非切割/碱基编辑的分子机制，但对高性能编辑器的工程化设计有参考价值。
abstract: CRISPR/Cas gene editing holds great promise for applications in agricultural breeding and gene therapy; however, native Cas proteins face bottlenecks such as off-target effects, PAM limitations, and delivery challenges. This review explores a three-tiered, progressive, and synergistic analytical framework comprising directed evolution, rational structural design, and integrated protein engineering. Following the logic of "random exploration-precision modification-system integration," it systematically clarifies the principles, advantages, disadvantages, and complementary interactions among these three optimization techniques. By comprehensively mapping the entire technical pathway for Cas protein improvement, this study fills a gap in systematic analysis within the field and provides a theoretical framework for tiered, synergistic modification to support the development of high-performance editors. The paper further analyzes a novel research and development paradigm in which AI and protein language models profoundly empower Cas modification. It summarizes intelligent toolchains such as structure prediction, virtual mutation, and de novo design of artificial Cas proteins, and highlights the unique advantages of AI in overcoming the performance trade-offs inherent in traditional protein engineering. At the same time, it identifies existing challenges, such as data scarcity and insufficient model interpretability, and looks ahead to how multimodal gene-editing large language models and automated closed-loop experimental systems will drive the iterative development of miniaturized, broad-spectrum, and highly precise editing tools, thereby facilitating the clinical and industrial implementation of gene-editing technologies.
abstract_zh: CRISPR/Cas基因编辑在农业育种和基因治疗中具有广阔的应用前景，然而天然Cas蛋白面临脱靶效应、PAM限制和递送挑战等瓶颈。本综述探讨了一个由定向进化、理性结构设计和整合蛋白质工程组成的三层递进、协同增效的分析框架。遵循“随机探索—精准修饰—系统整合”的逻辑，系统阐明了这三种优化技术的原理、优缺点及互补互动关系。通过全面绘制Cas蛋白改良的完整技术路径，本研究填补了该领域系统分析的空白，并为分层协同修饰提供了理论框架，以支持高性能编辑器的开发。本文进一步分析了AI和蛋白质语言模型深度赋能Cas修饰的新型研发范式，总结了结构预测、虚拟突变和人工Cas蛋白从头设计等智能工具链，并强调了AI在克服传统蛋白质工程固有性能权衡方面的独特优势。同时，指出了现有挑战，如数据稀缺和模型可解释性不足，并展望了多模态基因编辑大语言模型和自动化闭环实验系统将如何推动小型化、广谱性和高精度编辑工具的迭代发展，从而促进基因编辑技术的临床和产业化应用。
